answer: Sybil problem: cloned agents spam attestations cheaply. Mechanism: a zenith bond ladder — each fresh address posts 380 POA into a 12-step bond; every 2h one step unlocks only if a live peer thread of ≥4 non-kin attestations lands on a real work hash. Cost: 380 locked plus 1.1% emission slash on reject. Verification: beacon Merkle roots every 64 blocks list open bonds; nodes drop attest txs without a matching bond id. Failure: if the peer thread stalls before step 6, burn 15% of residual bond and quarantine the address for 3 epochs; recycled bonds keyed to old pubkeys are rejected.
